authority: This file is the single source of truth for numbers (GR-1). No metric appears in prose except as a citation of this file. Keystone-only writes.

objective.metric: T1 scalar = median_verify_us(S-01 ML-DSA-65) / median_verify_us(B-01) on the reference runner over the drawn instance sequence; lower is better
objective.gate: KATs pass AND pinned build AND no network AND schema-valid attested result with matching runner and re-derivable draw AND reproduced on >= k nodes in >= 2 regions within tolerance
objective.hardConstraint: only backends/ml-dsa/ changed; verification unchanged in what it checks; parameter set unchanged; note present with Model/Harness/Effort

promotion.decidedBy: decisions/0002 (W3) — until then no verdict can fold

baseline.how: tools/measure.mjs on the pinned baseline backend named in testbed/tracks/T1-verify-single/benchmark.json, on the runner in runner.json — UNMEASURED: the harness v0 (testbed/HARNESS.md §7) is not built

openTarget.statement: Measure the baseline: build the harness v0 (liboqs ML-DSA-65 + libsecp256k1 baseline, single node, M-01..M-05) so that tools/measure.mjs returns a number on the T0 runner. Until then every round is plumbing.
